messages.subject: Separate modelling of binary and poisson: zeroinflatedpoisson0 vs  zeroinflatedpoisson1
parts:
I see that I can model the binomial and Poisson parts separately if I use zeroinflatedpoisson0. However, this assumes all my zeros are structural. Is there any way to do it for zeroinflatedpoisson1 as well, where I have both structural and sample zeros (and cannot tell which is which)? If I am able to, isn't this starting to be pretty similar to a hurdle model?

Also, in zeroinflatedpoisson1, I can calculate the fitted values with (1-theta_hat)*lambda_hat, right? I.e. : summary(model)[["hyperpar"]][1,1]*model$summary.fitted.values$mean
This gives me a very strange result. I here define theta_hat to be the estimated probability of a structural zero.
